summary: Iteration 2 focused on the NEW VIVACE features (Home directory, Country page, and visitor↔company chat) plus regression. Backend: 16 new pytest cases added in test_directory_and_chat.py (public directory + full chat round-trip incl. isolation, auth requirements, 404s, sender field, ordering). All 37 backend tests pass (21 existing + 16 new). Frontend: Playwright verified home renders without auth (60 country cards, Georgia sorted first with '8 კომპანია' badge), search returns country + city results, country card navigates to /country/Georgia (8 companies visible), company card opens public profile, unauth chat widget shows chat-login-button, authenticated visitor sent a message that appeared in the widget, owner login on curltest@test.com showed 2 conversations in Messages (შეტყობინებები) tab, owner reply appeared in the thread bubble. Existing seeded credentials curltest@test.com/test123 and visitor1@test.com/test123 both validated via API.

minor.issue: Aggregation runs on every request without caching or index. With country=='' filter this is fine for small volume but should have an index on {country:1} once dataset grows.

Does not validate that visitor_id has ever messaged this company; a company owner can send a reply to ANY user_id (creates a synthetic conversation with visitor_name='მომხმარებელი'). Not a security leak (visitor can only read own thread) but allows creation of orphan conversations.
No text validation — empty strings or arbitrarily long text are accepted. Consider max length and min length > 0.

issues: The visible '(1)' media thumbnail on the public profile appears as an empty box (broken image icon) when the media URL fails to load. Only cosmetic — the file endpoint returns 200 in backend tests. May be a stale media entry from a previous storage run.

action_items: Optional: add server-side text validation (non-empty, max length ~2000) on both chat POST endpoints.
Optional: in send_company_reply, verify that visitor_id has at least one message in this company's thread before allowing reply (prevents orphan conversations).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~529 lines; the chat + directory endpoints could be split into a routers/chat.py and routers/public.py module for maintainability.

send_company_reply looks up the visitor's message just to fetch visitor_name; if no prior message exists it silently falls back to 'მომხმარებელი' — creates orphan conversations because there's no ownership check on visitor_id.

chat_inbox re-computes conversation summaries in Python from a full messages scan on every poll (every 6s per owner). Once messages grow beyond a few thousand this needs an aggregation pipeline or a per-conversation summary collection.
list_companies has no pagination (returns up to 1000). Frontend Home relies on this via /companies-countries only, but the /companies endpoint should paginate as data grows.

Home.jsx calls City.getAllCities() (~150k rows) on every render mount which delays first interaction; already memoized but the initial CPU cost is significant. Consider lazy import or country-scoped lookup on demand.
ChatWidget/ChatInbox poll intervals (4s/6s) are set independently and will keep firing when tab is in background. Consider pausing polling when document.hidden.
test_credentials: Seeded: curltest@test.com / test123 (owner, Georgia, 2 active conversations after this run); visitor1@test.com / test123 (visitor). Fresh test accounts also created during run (test_owner_*, test_visitor_*, visitest_*@test.com).
seed_data_creation: Backend tests create fresh company owners with country=Georgia and fresh visitors per test run (idempotent). UI test registered visitest_1784639492@test.com and left 1 new conversation visible in curltest's inbox ('TEST Visitor UI' with a visitor msg + owner reply).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Two backend test files: backend_test.py (regression, 21 cases) and test_directory_and_chat.py (16 new cases for /api/companies, /api/companies-countries, and /api/chat/*). Run both with: `pytest /app/backend/tests/ --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml`. pytest.ini uses `-n 2 --dist loadscope` (fine, tests are class-scoped). Home page search: country match requires >=2 chars, city match >=3 chars. Chat is polling-based (visitor 4s, inbox 6s, thread 4s) — wait ~2-3s after send() before asserting. Georgia is guaranteed to have >=3 companies (curltest owns 3 seeded + tests add more). Visitor authentication is required for both POST/GET /api/chat/{company_id}/messages; unauth returns 401/403. Chat endpoint returns 404 for unknown company_id.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no bugs found requiring RCA.
